title: Morning brief
prompt:
Write the owner's morning brief: the two or three sentences at the top of Springroll's Home page.

Look at, quickly:
- What's already on Home: `curl -s localhost:8090/signals` (level needs = waiting on the owner; notable = worth knowing).
- Job runs in the last 24 hours: `curl -s localhost:8090/threads` (origin job:<name>, updated, status, preview) and `curl -s localhost:8090/jobs` (each job's last run and next run).
- Chats waiting on the owner: threads with status "waiting".
- Machine health, if the System View is installed: `curl -s localhost:8102/api/status`.
- Weather: `curl -s localhost:8000/api/weather` (skip if no place is set).
- Today's calendar, only if a calendar is connected (a Google Calendar MCP tool, or a calendar View's API). Skip it otherwise; don't mention that it's missing.

Write plain prose, no headings, bullets or emoji, under 70 words. Lead with anything that needs the owner, then what happened overnight that matters, then the shape of the day. Don't list every item (Home shows them); summarize. If nothing happened, say so in one short sentence. Post it with `signal --brief "<the text>"`, then end with the same text.
